description: This file defines the AgentDB class, a singleton thread-safe data storage for agent-related information in the prplMesh project. It includes structures for radios, backhaul, device configuration, neighbor devices, MLO configurations, and various agent states and policies.

classes.name: AgentDB
classes.description: Singleton class providing thread-safe access to agent's persistent data, including radios, backhaul, device configuration, neighbor devices, MLO configurations, and policies.

classes.name: AgentDB::SafeDB
classes.description: RAII wrapper for thread-safe access to AgentDB instance, locks mutex on creation and releases on destruction.

methods.name: AgentDB::get
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe wrapper to access the singleton AgentDB instance.

methods.name: AgentDB::init_data_model
methods.description: Initializes the data model with a shared pointer to Ambiorix.

methods.name: AgentDB::dm_set_agent_mac
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the agent in the data model.

methods.name: AgentDB::radio
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the radio data structure for a given interface name.

methods.name: AgentDB::add_radio
methods.description: Adds a new radio interface to the database.

methods.name: AgentDB::get_radios_list
methods.description: Returns a list of all radio objects in the database.

methods.name: AgentDB::remove_radio_from_radios_list
methods.description: Removes a radio from the internal list by interface name.

methods.name: AgentDB::get_radio_by_mac
methods.description: Finds the parent radio structure for a given MAC address, with optional hint for MAC type.

methods.name: AgentDB::erase_client
methods.description: Removes a client from associated clients, optionally from a specific BSSID.

methods.name: AgentDB::get_mac_by_ssid
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of an AP given its radio UID and SSID.

methods.name: AgentDB::get_ap_mld_mac_by_ssid
methods.description: Retrieves the MLD MAC of an MLO AP based on SSID.
